title: Estimate of the speed of the ISS.
description: Part of the European Astro Pi Challenge - Mission Space Lab - 23-24.

estimate_kmps.description: The estimate of the speed of the ISS in kilometres per second.

estimate_start.description: The start time of the time-window for which the estimated value specified in estimate_kmps is valid. Must be in UTC, ISO-8601 format.

estimate_end.description: The end time of the time-window for which the estimated value specified in estimate_kmps is valid. Must be in UTC, ISO-8601 format.
